services.name: Skydive jump
services.desc: The big day has finally arrived! You are becoming more and more excited? Maybe nervous? We know exactly what you are going through. Don’t worry! For 25 years, skydiving has been our profession and our entire team has more than 175 000 jumps of experience. Remember, you are on the verge of a unique experience that will change your life. Jump at 9000′ - This option will allow you to experience a 9000′ tandem skydive. At 5000′, after only 20 seconds of free fall, your instructor will deploy the parachute and you will be able to enjoy the experience of flying under the canopy. Buy now ! Jump at 13 500′ - Our most popular option for a first skydive, that will allow you to get the full experience

blurb: Parachute Montréal is a skydiving center with over 30 years of experience. They specialize in tandem skydiving jumps. The team is passionate and offers professional rigging services.
